The energy of gravity is nonlocal in GR: gravitational potential energy contributes (negatively) nonlocally to the total energy, and gravitational waves can carry (positive) nonlocal energy away from a system. paragraphs.source_en: Answer: The gravitational field certainly is special. Somehow there is an irony in the history of the subject: Newton started physics with the theory of gravity and this theory was the original paradigm for all other physical interactions. But now it turns out that gravity is in fact distinctly different from other interactions.
